note: The refusal twin of split-partition-implicit-case-twins-bind-while-another-split-is-pending, with the same source: here a split is declared for every delivered literal (Kon and KON to 1.5.kon, LEFT to 1.5.left) beside the unmatched 1.5.other, so the family's ambiguity has no unresolved native row left to explain. The replaced test's second leg refused an ambiguity that lacks an unresolved native identity, with this message. The build refuses with the located naming_split_unmatched, naming the unmatched entry (sample.toml's [[variable]] 1.5.other), even in diagnostic mode (source_scope.py `_attribute_unresolved_names`). It was the bare ValueError `ambiguous naming lacks an unresolved native identity` until the located-errors fix. The pending twin leaves the same unmatched split silently unused, so a withhold-and-report outcome here needs the compile that mints the ambiguity to change first; that will change this expectation. Found by #1313.
fails_if: `_attribute_unresolved_names` (source_scope.py) drops its `if not unresolved.get(key)` refusal, so an ambiguity whose family is fully bound passes silently instead of stopping the build, or refuses without the located `naming_split_unmatched` naming the unmatched entry

sources.description: Variable 5 delivers Kon in 2020 (CVID 20), KON in 2021 (CVID 21) and LEFT in 2021 (CVID 22).
